node.statement: Re-derive the sign-split bound inside node 1.3.2. Put a_j = P_vj, h_j = h(p_j), a_j^+ = max(a_j,0), and a_j^- = max(-a_j,0). Since P is an exact signed idempotent, P^2 = P and P 1 = 1, so p_v = sum_j a_j p_j and sum_j a_j = 1. Affineness of h and h(p_v)=0 give 0 = sum_j a_j h_j. As a_j = a_j^+ - a_j^- and the sums are finite, sum_j a_j^+ h_j = sum_j a_j^- h_j. Since 0 <= h_j <= 1 and a_j^- >= 0, sum_j a_j^- h_j <= sum_j a_j^- = sum_j max(-P_vj,0) = nu_v. Hence sum_j a_j^+ h_j <= nu_v.
